methods.description: Use Pnot=1−P from a given probability, in fraction/decimal/percentage form.
Count equally likely separate objects to find the event probability, subtract from1; check by counting every non-event object and explain efficiency.
For exhaustive disjoint categories add probabilities of all excluded categories, then subtract the sum from1; interpret the remaining event.
